relationships.subject: morphine
relationships.evidence_quote: counteracting morphine-induced increase of VEGF-A in the nervous system

relationships.subject: ultramicronized palmitoylethanolamide
relationships.evidence_quote: PEA resulted in lower expression of VEGF-A in dorsal root ganglia (DRG) and spinal cord compared to morphine alone

relationships.subject: ultramicronized palmitoylethanolamide
relationships.evidence_quote: Preemptive and concomitant treatment with ultramicronized PEA delayed morphine tolerance and potentiated the analgesic effect of morphine

relationships.subject: bevacizumab
relationships.evidence_quote: The anti-VEGF-A monoclonal antibody bevacizumab was used as a reference drug.

key_findings: Ultramicronized PEA delayed morphine tolerance and lowered morphine-induced VEGF-A in DRG and spinal cord and plasma sFLT-1.
Bevacizumab mimicked PEA's effect on morphine tolerance and had analgesic effect alone.
